digest.component_or_area: Jira adapters (Cloud vs Data Center reconciler)
propositions: Cloud adapter (ACLI-based) and Data Center adapter (pycontribs-based) share a backend port but were hardened independently with asymmetric test coverage
Data Center adapter lacks byte-for-byte value pinning for field sanitizer boundaries, identity label forms, and probe branches that Cloud possesses
Data Center adapter comment and description convergence behavior across multiple passes has not been tested against the documented character limits
The ticket-type map is duplicated across adapters and must be single-sourced with a regression guard to prevent divergence
Several existing tests assert shape contracts only and would pass with incorrect field values, creating false confidence in correctness
Cloud's whole-project readers lack pagination and rate-limiting coverage that Data Center harness discovered
